title: Lumière — Stained Glass Studio
description: Cut a stained-glass window from four tracery generators, glaze it pane by pane, then move the sun and export it.
concept: A glazier's bench in a single file. Four generators cut the cartoon — a rose window built on a shared angular grid, a Gothic lancet filled with diamond quarries, Voronoi shards, and relaxed Art-Nouveau glass with watertight organic edges — and every pane is then yours to reglaze by tapping it. Light is a real part of the design: a draggable sun casts falloff and bloom through the glass, and it can drift on its own. Finished windows leave as a ×2 PNG, a vector SVG with one path per pane, a .json design file, or a share link.
features: Four tracery generators — rose, lancet, Voronoi shards, Art-Nouveau organic
Pane painter: tap or drag to glaze, eyedropper, revert-to-generated, 400-step undo
Eight leaded palettes plus live recolouring of any swatch
Draggable sun with falloff, bloom, warmth and beam spread — or let it drift
Tunable tracery: sectors, bands, cusping, quarry size, pane count, organic edge
Export ×2 PNG, vector SVG, .json design file, and a share link in the URL hash
Six-slot studio shelf with thumbnails, kept in localStorage

interaction.mouse: Drag across panes to sweep a colour; with the sun tool, drag to move the light
interaction.click: Tap a pane to glaze it with the selected swatch; tap a palette to reglaze the whole window
interaction.touch: Full touch support via Pointer Events; the control panel becomes a bottom sheet
interaction.keyboard: 1–4 tracery · R reseed · Z undo · E export PNG · D drift the sun · S sun tool
